title: Marketplace module shipped on a new modular platform
outcome: Bizowl moved to a modular platform with a marketplace module and its existing data carried over.
context: Bizowl is building a Startup OS for India: one platform that brings together the services, people and resources founders need to start, run and grow a business. Its founder, Prashant Sirohi, wanted a product that connects those experiences into one system and can grow with the ecosystem.
problem: Bizowl's first product, built on React, Node.js and Firebase, had become hard to extend: every new feature added complexity, and the codebase lacked the structure the product's ambitions needed. Users also weren't sure what the platform was for or what to do next.
built: Instead of adding more features to the old foundation, we designed a new modular platform around reusable core services, shipped the marketplace module on it with a clearer purpose, redesigned navigation around clarity, and migrated existing client and partner data.

components.name: Modular architecture
components.detail: Shared building blocks and reusable core services, on a stack chosen for long-term maintainability.

components.name: Marketplace module
components.detail: Shipped with a clear role in the wider Bizowl ecosystem, so users know what they can do.

components.name: Experience redesign
components.detail: Navigation rebuilt so people understand the platform and where to go next.

components.name: Data migration
components.detail: Existing client and partner data carried over to the new platform.

result: Marketplace module live on a new modular platform, with existing client and partner data migrated and a clearer experience for users.
resultDefinition: Qualitative: delivery of a module, a data migration and a redesigned experience.
